I will put DAP and urea because the soil needs help, and I also have cow manure from my animals. I will buy improved seed from the agro-dealer for this plot because it gives better yield. I do not need chemicals for pests on such a small piece — my family can remove weeds by hand, and the rains in Mbeya are good enough. My wife and children will help with the work; it is not big enough to hire anyone.
